baseline_models.mechanism: Settled security is exposed as dependence on restraint: the same overhead domain that covers the addressees can become the route by which a released, pebble-bearing wind descends against them.

activation_trace.role: Heart-settling safety supplies the complacent state that the question destabilizes.
What is above and overshadows supplies the overhead domain whose apparent cover can become exposure.
Release and dispatch supply the switch from withheld danger to an event sent against the addressees.
A fierce wind carrying grit or pebbles gives the released threat its downward, abrasive material force.

changed_reading.before: A general threat of bad weather from the sky.
changed_reading.after: A challenge to false security: temporary restraint has been mistaken for immunity, although the overhead cover can be turned into a delivery path.

baseline_models.mechanism: The result particle and future verb place knowledge after the threatened event. Warning first tries to awaken caution; if that fails, its character is learned by encounter rather than merely by report.

activation_trace.role: Disclosure to the knower supplies the later recognition produced by the consequence.
Warning that awakens caution supplies the prior message whose force will become known.
The grit-bearing wind supplies the event that converts verbal warning into experienced knowledge.

changed_reading.before: The verse adds a generic warning after naming a storm.
changed_reading.after: The verse stages two epistemic phases: an alert can be heeded now, or its quality can be learned later through the event it announced.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding verse repeats the security and heaven frame but routes danger through sinking and oscillating earth. The focus verse then routes danger from overhead, so the pair removes both lower support and upper shelter.

activation_trace.role: The stone-bearing wind supplies the upper arm of the paired physical threat.
The repeated state of felt safety marks both verses as a single audit of assumed security.
The repeated overhead domain fixes one source frame while the two verses vary the path of danger.
Earth sinking supplies the downward failure of what seemed to support the addressees.
The lower realm opposite the sky makes the spatial complement to the focus verse explicit.
Oscillation and surging remove the ground's expected stability before the focus verse removes overhead safety.

structural_cues: 67:16 and 67:17 repeat أَمِنتُم مَّن فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ أَن and then alternate earth-collapse and overhead-dispatch predicates.
The adjacent pair opposes the lower support named in 67:16 to the blast sent عَلَيْكُمْ in 67:17.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a repeated frame plus lower and upper hazards; I infer that the pair removes refuge along the vertical axis. A live alternative is that the verses simply list two independent punishments.

changed_reading.before: The focus verse threatens one isolated overhead event.
changed_reading.after: It is the second arm of a two-sided spatial undoing: the ground can fail beneath and the apparent cover can discharge from above.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah first places stone-like rujum in the adorned sky, then the focus releases a pebble-bearing blast downward, while the punishment sequence repeatedly casts human groups into the blaze. The focus event becomes the hinge of a reciprocal casting pattern.

activation_trace.role: Pebbles and gravel supply the material that links the focus blast to the sky's stone imagery.
The carrying wind supplies the downward transport phase of the casting pattern.
Gathered stone material gives the sky's rujum a projectile stock that anticipates the gravel blast.
Ignited fire supplies the destination later reached by those who are themselves cast.
Throwing something until it lies there reverses the direction from stones cast down to people cast in.
The repeated passive casting makes the reversal systematic rather than a single verbal coincidence.
A human group supplies the collective object of the return casting.

structural_cues: 67:5 joins the lowest sky to رُجُومًا, while 67:17 sends a gravel-bearing agent عَلَيْكُمْ.
67:7 and 67:8 repeat passive forms of ألقى for people entering the fire sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies stone material, a downward carrier, repeated throwing, and a blaze; I infer a reciprocal choreography in which rejection returns the act of casting upon the rejecters. A live alternative is that these are separate punishment images without a designed material exchange.

changed_reading.before: The حاصب is an isolated meteorological punishment.
changed_reading.after: It occupies the middle of a casting architecture: stone-like matter is stationed above and sent down, while rejecting groups are cast into the ignited destination.

context_deltas.mechanism: Context turns the focus future knowledge into closure of an evidentiary loop: a warner is asked about, admitted, and denied; the next verse echoes كَيْف with severe نكير; later the speaker is explicitly a warner, and the denied event is finally seen when near.

activation_trace.role: Later disclosure supplies the moment when the warning's truth becomes unavoidable knowledge.
The focus warning is the message whose earlier reception and later realization the context unfolds.
The question about a warning establishes that caution was offered before consequence.
The admitted arrival of a warner removes lack of notice as the cause of later knowledge.
Treating the message as false supplies the interruption between warning and compelled recognition.
A severe, strange outcome sharpens the immediate كيف echo as realized repudiation rather than another notice.
The speaker's bounded role as a clear warner keeps the pre-event phase communicative rather than coercive.
Direct sight supplies the sensory mode by which denied warning becomes recognized event.
The event's rush into nearness supplies the temporal threshold at which warning becomes sight.

structural_cues: 67:17 كَيْفَ نَذِيرِ is answered immediately by 67:18 فَكَيْفَ كَانَ نَكِيرِ after mention of prior denial.
The packet sequence moves from hearing a warning in 67:8-9 to seeing the demanded event near in 67:27.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies warning, admission, denial, an immediate كيف echo, and later sight; I infer that فَسَتَعْلَمُونَ means retroactive recognition of an already delivered warning. A live alternative is a generic discovery of punishment's severity without this evidentiary-loop emphasis.

changed_reading.before: The storm teaches the addressees a new fact.
changed_reading.after: The event closes a loop: what was first heard and rejected is later seen and recognized in the severe form the warning had announced.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context distributes knowledge asymmetrically. Hidden speech and created beings are already known, knowledge is said to be with God while the messenger warns, and the addressees repeatedly receive future تَعْلَمُونَ. Their later knowing is consequence, not parity with prior knowledge.

activation_trace.role: Future disclosure marks the delayed and recipient-side position in the knowledge sequence.
Warning mediates between knowledge already held and knowledge the addressees will acquire.
Knowledge of concealed and public speech supplies the already-complete epistemic side of the contrast.
The creator's knowing supplies a causal basis for prior knowledge rather than a prediction learned later.
Knowledge located with God distinguishes possession of knowledge from the messenger's task of warning.
The exact second-person future knowing formula confirms delayed disclosure as a repeated endpoint.

structural_cues: Present knowledge language in 67:13-14 precedes second-person future knowledge in 67:17 and 67:29.
67:26 explicitly separates knowledge located with God from the speaker's role as warner.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies present prior knowledge, bounded warning, and repeated future human knowing; I infer an epistemic handoff in which warning carries prior knowledge toward later compelled recognition. A live alternative is that each knowledge statement serves only its local argument.

changed_reading.before: فَسَتَعْلَمُونَ is only a conventional consequence marker.
changed_reading.after: It marks the delayed end of an asymmetric knowledge chain: the warned addressees learn last, through the consequence, what was already known and communicated.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus dispatch is activated by later acts of holding: birds remain aloft because they are held, and provision can be withheld. Sending the blast is therefore readable as a controlled move from restraint to release within the same ordered environment.

activation_trace.role: Release in contrast with holding supplies the active side of the governance switch.
Holding birds aloft supplies visible restraint within the same overhead field from which the blast may be released.
Withholding provision generalizes restraint as an actively controlled condition rather than an absence of power.

structural_cues: The focus يرسل is followed by 67:19 ما يمسكهن and 67:21 إن أمسك رزقه.
67:19 locates held birds فوقهم, preserving the same overhead axis as the focus threat.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies release, two acts of holding, and a shared overhead field; I infer that danger appears when restraint is changed, not when order disappears. A live alternative is that storm, bird flight, and provision are independent examples of power.

changed_reading.before: A storm begins as a random rupture of normal conditions.
changed_reading.after: The blast is a deliberate release within a system whose ordinary mercy is visible as continuous holding and withholding.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same root that names complacent security in the focus verse later names belief, is joined to reliance, and is followed by the same فَسَتَعْلَمُونَ formula. The contrast does not reject every settled heart; it contrasts presumed immunity with security regrounded as faith and dependence.

activation_trace.role: Felt safety supplies the challenged mode of heart-settling that assumes immunity from consequence.
The first future knowing formula supplies one endpoint for the root-level contrast.
Belief as heart-settling assent supplies the constructive counterpart to complacent security.
Reliance supplies the relation of dependence that distinguishes faith from presumed self-security.
The repeated future knowing formula places both modes of security before a coming disclosure of their grounds.

structural_cues: 67:17 أَمِنتُم and 67:29 ءَامَنَّا activate different branches of the same root.
Both root occurrences are followed in their verses by فَسَتَعْلَمُونَ.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a same-root branch shift, explicit reliance, and a repeated future formula; I infer a contrast between misplaced security and regrounded trust. A live alternative is that the recurrence is only morphological and the two verses make unrelated points.

changed_reading.before: The question condemns the condition of feeling secure as such.
changed_reading.after: It interrogates what security rests on: presumed insulation from the one above is opposed by belief and acknowledged reliance on the Merciful.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it selects the wind-raised dust branch of تَمُورُ rather than its more immediate oscillation branch and joins two adjacent hazards into one material circuit. It remains anchored in the focus gravel-bearing wind and the packet's م و ر branch inventory. Render it only as a possible physical analogy, not as a claim that either word lexically entails the whole circuit.

activation_trace.role: A wind that raises or carries grit supplies the returning airborne half of the proposed material circuit.
Dust stirred by wind supplies material lifted from the unstable ground before it is imagined as descending gravel.

changed_reading.before: 67:16 and 67:17 name two discrete earth and sky events.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the pair can image one dust-and-gravel circulation: disturbed ground feeds an airborne load that returns from above as bombardment.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the successive-batches branch of ر س ل for a singular حاصب and lets the repeated casting of a فوج supply serial rhythm. It remains anchored in يُرْسِلَ and a valid focus branch, with context providing grouped recurrence. Render it as an aspectual possibility or image of waves, not as a required grammatical value.

activation_trace.role: Successive batches supply a possible pulsed or wave-like aspect to the dispatch.
The grit-bearing wind supplies the event that may arrive in successive fronts.
Repeated casting supplies the recurrent action that activates a serial rather than instantaneous image.
A group arriving under كلما supplies the batch structure mirrored in the proposed storm waves.

changed_reading.before: The verse threatens one undifferentiated storm event.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the dispatch can be heard as successive grit-bearing fronts, formally echoed by groups entering consequence one after another.

strongest_changes: The exact 67:16 parallel turns the focus threat into the upper half of a ground-and-sky dismantling of false security.
The warning sequence makes future knowledge retroactive recognition of a notice already received and denied, especially through the كَيْفَ نَذِيرِ and فَكَيْفَ كَانَ نَكِيرِ echo.
67:29 regrounds the ء م ن root from presumed immunity to belief and reliance, with فَسَتَعْلَمُونَ repeated after both configurations.
Later holding language makes the blast a controlled release within an ordered environment rather than random disorder.
summary.what_was_special: Exact constructions and same-root branch shifts did more work than broad themes: the paired security questions, the warning and repudiation echo, the release-hold opposition, and the move from أَمِنتُم to ءَامَنَّا each changed the focus mechanism while remaining word-anchored.
remaining_uncertainties: The packet does not settle whether the overhead phrase should be weighted chiefly as spatial location, covering authority, or both.
The reciprocal-casting, dust-circuit, and serial-dispatch readings depend on cross-verse material or aspectual analogy and should remain qualified.
The compact construction كَيْفَ نَذِيرِ permits more than one rendering of how warning and realized consequence relate.
